scoring_principles.overall_score: weighted domain score adjusted for evidence confidence and critical-gap penalties

maturity_scale.1: Reactive — little formalization; recovery depends on individuals.
maturity_scale.2: Documented — policies/plans exist but capability is inconsistent.
maturity_scale.3: Defined — standardized processes, ownership and tiering exist.
maturity_scale.4: Tested — recovery is exercised with evidence and gaps are remediated.
maturity_scale.5: Adaptive — resilience is continuously validated, automated where appropriate and integrated into architecture/investment decisions.

critical_gap_penalties.condition: critical business service has no defined impact tolerance or RTO/RPO
critical service recovery plan has never been tested
critical data has no recoverable backup
backup exists but restore has not been proven
critical recovery relies on the same failure domain as production
critical service has unmanaged single-provider concentration risk
identity/control plane compromise can block recovery and no alternate recovery path exists
critical service has a documented DR plan but no evidence it meets the required RTO/RPO

rating_bands.label: Critical Exposure
rating_bands.executive_message: Material resilience exposure requires immediate risk treatment.

rating_bands.label: Fragile
rating_bands.executive_message: Core resilience capabilities exist but significant gaps could disrupt critical services.

rating_bands.label: Managed
rating_bands.executive_message: Resilience is established but important capability and evidence gaps remain.

rating_bands.label: Resilient
rating_bands.executive_message: Strong resilience foundation with targeted improvement opportunities.

rating_bands.label: Adaptive
rating_bands.executive_message: Resilience is engineered, tested and continuously improved.

recommendation_logic.principle: Never select a DR pattern from score alone.
strategy_order: eliminate patterns that cannot meet requirements
provide at least one viable alternative
